from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers (from the collection) that this paper explicitly references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
